description: The risk and return scorecard for one ETF against its own ETFIQ benchmark, or with versus, two ETFs side by side: total, annualised and price return, volatility, drawdown, Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, beta, R2, capture, tracking error and alpha with t-stat and 95% range, plus window and return count. alpha_test.significant is true only when |t| is at least 2 and the range excludes zero.

ticker.description: One fund's ticker, such as JEPI.

versus.description: Optional: a second fund, for the pair scorecard.

name: etf_scorecard

data.description: The answer; null on a refusal.

error.description: Refusal only: what is not published.
